frozen_scientific_and_release_contract.rule: Gates, thresholds, samples, seeds, models, prompts, scientific contracts, gold data, the 24-field action authorization shape and all heldout locks remain byte-identical.

binding_conflict_and_resolution.fact: Both existing schemas hard-code the lost series token and hidden ledger root in their registered executionBinding branch, so a fresh token and visible ledger cannot validate against those exact registered constants.
binding_conflict_and_resolution.resolution: Keep both existing schema files byte-identical and add series-2 binding profiles during the preregistration-amendment stage. The new profiles are canonical copies whose only differences are the new schema identity, active series-2 preregistration/schema lineage, fresh registered token and visible ledger root; all scientific, safety, evaluation and release-decision semantics remain identical.
binding_conflict_and_resolution.required_owner_companion_classification: The additive series-2 files are binding-only governance profiles, not a relaxation or mutation of the frozen scientific/release contract.
binding_conflict_and_resolution.schema_construction_order: Create the series-2 release schema first and compute its SHA-256; then bind that digest into the series-2 bundle schema release_authorization_schema lineage pointer. The amendment binds the final path/SHA/bytes of both. No hash fallback or self-reference is permitted.

constant_isolation.rule: The series-2 token function uses SERIES_2_TOKEN_SEED_SHA256. It must not overwrite, alias or reinterpret INCIDENT_SHA256, which continues to bind the original v2.1 consumed-attempt incident and carry-forward lineage.

epoch_origin_rule.timing_clarification: At design time the landed registered bytes are epoch 4. The minimal series-2 implementation is epoch 5. After that implementation lands, series-2 ordinal 1 binds the then-current landed epoch 5.

durable_storage_options.recommendation_reason: Only option (a) combines a visible non-hidden primary path with a second location designed for off-machine synchronization without adding a Git evidence-container protocol.
durable_storage_options.W7_scope_and_owner_confirmation: The post-incident owner brief explicitly nominates /Users/ouyangduning/Documents/project/interesting/AlphaPilot-AI-EVIDENCE-DO-NOT-DELETE as option (a), so this proposal does not silently substitute another root. It is outside the hidden .alphapilot-* evidence naming/cleanup class but remains under the broader project/interesting parent used during the manual cleanup. The companion must explicitly accept that residual broad-parent human-deletion risk together with the visible DO-NOT-DELETE name and iCloud second copy; otherwise it must choose a different primary root before preregistration and rebind every registered ledger/receipt/schema path. The series-token formula is independent of ledger root, so such a path decision does not change the token.

option_a.attempt_1_precondition: The owner enables iCloud Drive, then explicitly provisions the two exact SERIES-000002-* container directories as mode 0700. An independent preflight proves each container and every ancestor is owner-controlled, non-symlink and non-overlapping; the registered PRIMARY-LEDGER, SEALED-LEDGER-SNAPSHOTS and both MIRROR-RECEIPTS leaves must still be absent. Existing SeriesLedger.open creates only the primary leaf, so recursive parent creation is forbidden and not inferred.
option_a.machine_claim_boundary: A local re-read can prove only LOCAL_SECOND_COPY_VERIFIED. It must not claim asynchronous iCloud upload or off-device presence; the owner separately confirms the synchronization facility is active.

option_b.mechanism: Push a deterministic evidence container to orphan branch evidence/series-2.

option_c.risk: Protects against path-scoped accidental deletion but not disk loss, machine loss or same-volume corruption.

primary_seal_semantics: While holding the exclusive series lock, persist the primary terminal with the existing create-only rules and fsync every file and directory.
Once the primary terminal is durable, the attempt is sealed and its terminal outcome is irreversible.

If a process dies before terminalization, the next lock holder first replays and classifies the persisted attempt as INCOMPLETE_UNTERMINALIZED, freezes exactly the primary bytes then present, keeps terminal.json absent, and must finish that frozen-history mirror before allocating a later ordinal.
A later mirror failure must never delete, rewrite, roll back or reclassify the sealed terminal attempt or the frozen incomplete primary bytes.
attempt_seal_and_second_copy_protocol.snapshot_scope: After each terminal seal, and before carrying any replay-confirmed INCOMPLETE_UNTERMINALIZED record into a later ordinal, copy the entire live ledger as of that ordinal, including series.json and all attempts through the sealed or frozen ordinal, into a new create-only secondary snapshot.
copy_algorithm: continue holding the series lock and replay the complete primary history
compute the existing sorted live-ledger inventory and Merkle root plus path, mode, bytes, SHA-256, file count, total bytes and history root

reject symlink, hardlink, special-file, alias and overlapping primary/secondary ancestors; prohibit clonefile/reflink APIs and copy with explicit read/write, without claiming that APFS extent sharing can be detected after the fact

on the first mirror only, create the registered secondary snapshot root and both registered receipt roots with one-level create-only mkdir mode 0700 under the already provisioned SERIES-000002-* containers, then fsync all three parents; on later mirrors require those roots to exist with the exact owner, mode and non-alias properties
copy file bytes into a unique same-parent staging directory with O_EXCL; directories are 0700 and files are 0600
fsync each file, each directory and the staging parent
independently re-read the secondary tree and recompute the same inventory, history root and live-ledger root
require exact equality of relative paths, modes, bytes, per-file SHA-256, history root and live-ledger root

on exact macOS publish the same-parent staging directory only with renameatx_np(..., RENAME_EXCL=0x00000004), require success, fsync the final parent after rename, and re-read the published tree once more; absent-check plus os.rename is forbidden because it can overwrite after a TOCTOU race

construct one canonical receipt byte string and publish it with O_CREAT|O_EXCL under both registered MIRROR-RECEIPTS-DO-NOT-DELETE roots using the exact same filename; fsync each receipt and parent, then require the two independently re-read receipt files to be byte-identical
